_about: Source manifest (curated input to the ingestion pipeline).
Every field records what is stated in the downloaded document itself or how it was obtained.
date_issued is used only if date_evidence is found verbatim in the extracted text; the build blanks it otherwise.
effective_status and amendment_status are 'not verified' / 'not checked': nobody has verified commencement or later amendments, so the pipeline must not claim it.
kbs lists the knowledge bases a document is assigned to; kb_basis cites the DOCX section that assigns it.
The generated record of what was actually ingested (checksums, chunk counts, model) is knowledge_base/ingestion_manifest.json.
